theorems.name: Submission.aal_allard_subball_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ ρ → closedBall z r ⊆ closedBall 0 ρ → closedBall z r ⊆ U ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall z r, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂V.weight < ⊤ ∧ V.scaledLpNorm H p z r ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ ∧ V.weight (closedBall z r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + δ) * (unitBallVolume n * ρ ^ n))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
